english.title: Erect / demolish a structure / leave material / machinery on / in proximity to the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) not being an authorised person

(A)_[erected a structure, namely **(..SPECIFY THE STRUCTURE..),]_
(B)_[demolished or dismantled a structure, namely **(..SPECIFY THE STRUCTURE..),]_
(C)_[left material or matter, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MATERIAL OR MATTER..),]_
(D)_[left machinery, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MACHINERY..),]_
(E)_[operated machinery, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MACHINERY..),]_

on or in proximity to a part of the Croydon Tramlink System, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OR AREA..)
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 12(4)(a) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
